# Growth Stocks Deep Dive Update

Report 126 | Published 2023-12-23 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2023-12-23/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/126.json)

Growth valuations and monetary alternatives.

The strongest dated result is Bitcoin being substantially higher at end-2025; Adobe also suffered the warned-of one-to-two-year correction. These coexist with poor Pepsi sensitivity and unresolved five-year growth forecasts. The PEG arithmetic is plainly incorrect. BTFP maturity timing and Argentina intermediary policy need more precision than the narrative provides. Undated valuation screens are not scored as automatic wins or misses from prices alone.

**Coverage:** All numbered source blocks and chart labels read. All material macro, digital-asset and investment theses are reviewed. Routine holdings lists, incidental statistics and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

### 126-C02

**BTFP arbitrage expires**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Mixed |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | BTFP |
| Source blocks | 14 |
| Thesis family | btfp-arbitrage-liquidity |

The borrowing/reserve-rate arbitrage was real enough for the Fed to close it in January. March ended new lending, not the entire outstanding balance: loans could remain for a year. A $130 billion immediate March drain would misstate the maturity schedule. The taxpayer-cost statement also depends on future Fed remittances, not an immediate tax bill.

**Direction:** The assessment distinguishes the observed result from the proposed explanation.

**Timing:** No fixed author endpoint; any numerical sensitivity is evaluator-defined.

**Mechanism:** Observed co-movement or returns alone do not establish the proposed causal mechanism.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [BTFP stops new lending March 11](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20240124a.htm) | Federal Reserve | 2024-01-24 | Verified in the audit

New BTFP loans stopped March 11, 2024; existing loans remained subject to their terms. New borrowing rates were floored at IORB, removing the rate-arbitrage incentive. Term lending could last one year.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

- [Ethereum scaling documentation](https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/scaling/) | Ethereum.org | Verified in the audit

Rollups execute outside Ethereum L1 while using it for settlement or data. Scaling systems have distinct security and interoperability properties; sidechains do not inherit the same security as rollups.

- [Transaction and UTXO documentation](https://developer.bitcoin.org/devguide/transactions.html) | Bitcoin developer documentation | Verified in the audit

Each transaction spends existing outputs as inputs and creates new outputs. Transaction fees and input sizes make small outputs uneconomic at sufficiently high fee rates; outputs can be consolidated when fees are low.

## Framework lessons

- Separate business quality from entry valuation.

## Verification limitations

- Retrieved November 7, 2026; the current webpage is not authenticated as the original publication-date wording.
- Chart labels were read but pixels and proprietary indicator vintages were not inspected.
- Adjusted-close evidence is a vendor proxy for reinvested distributions and splits, in USD without fees or taxes. It does not reconstruct actual portfolio trades. Chosen sensitivity windows are not author deadlines. Macro series use latest vintages.
